shellCommands.command: npm install next react react-dom 2>&1 | tail -5

sed -i 's#\.\./\.\./lib/#../../../lib/#; s#\.\./\.\./components/#../../../components/#' "app/books/[id]/page.jsx" && sed -i 's#\.\./\.\./\.\./lib/#../../../../lib/#' "app/api/books/[id]/route.js" && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
PORT=3100 npm run start >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 & sleep 4; curl -s localhost:3100 | grep -o "Currently reading\|Finished\|Left Hand of Darkness\|Project Hail Mary" | sort -u

ID=$(curl -s -X POST localhost:3100/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Piranesi","author":"Susanna Clarke","notes":"Dreamy."}' | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0)).id') && curl -s -X PATCH localhost:3100/api/books/$ID -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"finished"}' | node -pe 'const b=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0)); b.status+" "+b.finishedAt' && curl -s localhost:3100/books/$ID | grep -o "Piranesi\|Susanna Clarke\|Dreamy.\|finished" | sort -u && curl -s -X POST localhost:3100/api/books -d '{"title":""}' | head -1 && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3100/books/nope && node -e 'const b=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("data/books.json"));console.log("json books:",b.length)'
kill %1 2>/dev/null; git checkout -- data/books.json 2>/dev/null || true; git status --short
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -s -m 2 localhost:3100 >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "server stopped"
